title: Merge two sorted arrays
summary: Return one sorted array holding every element of the two sorted arrays `first` and `second`.
hints: Imagine two sorted piles of numbered cards, face up. To build one sorted pile, which cards do you need to look at for your next pick?
Only the front item of each array can be the next smallest. Keep one position in each array and repeatedly take the smaller front item.
Loop while both positions are in range, copying the smaller item and advancing that position. Afterwards, copy whatever remains in the array that is not finished.
takeaway: Because both inputs are already sorted, a single pass with two positions is O(n + m). Joining and re-sorting works but throws that ordering away and costs O((n + m) log(n + m)).
